verdict.rationale: Anytype's first-party Agents Skill says an agent can run scripts against your Anytype data programmatically to handle bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks. This rests on the local API, which lets agents read, search, and modify Objects, plus the headless CLI for scripting. Bulk work is therefore done by agent-written scripts rather than a documented native batch operation, and there is no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API endpoint or in-app multi-item bulk edit, detail on scale and limits of bulk changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
